_note: Electricity provider is confirmed by an official LGU-issued notice and the CENPELCO website (cenpelco.com, accessed 2026-09-04). electricity.role: Electric distribution cooperative serving San Carlos City and central Pangasinan
evidence: Official City Government notice "CENPELCO's Implementation of Mass Disconnection in San Carlos, Pangasinan" (LGU site, archived 2025-12-07)
CENPELCO website confirms San Carlos City is served via its "San Carlos City (Main)" area office
electricity.contact_gaps: Customer hotlines, email, main office street address, office hours, and the San Carlos City (Main) direct phone are unverified - obtain from CENPELCO/NEA.
electricity.magna_carta_note: The LGU disconnection notice references the Magna Carta for Electricity Consumers, which provides a 48-hour grace period after a disconnection notice before power is cut.
